name: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of scientific research reagents and laboratory consumables primarily under Aladdin and i-quip brands in China and internationally.
